title: Training centre upgrades its equipment
summary: New engine room simulators and virtual reality systems have been installed for emergency procedure training.

body.text: The university training centre has received new equipment. Engine room simulators have been upgraded and virtual reality scenarios added for emergency response training.
The upgrade will bring cadet training closer to real shipboard conditions.
